name: Panta WholeFleet Peterbilt Fault Code Reference
source: WholeFleet Diagnostics - The Ultimate Peterbilt Fault Code List
usage_note: Curated retrieval index based only on the supplied WholeFleet page. Preserve the source's P-code terminology. Peterbilt commonly uses PACCAR MX or Cummins engines; identify engine/controller and exact DTC before repair. A listed fault description is not proof that a named component has failed.

documents.title: How to read Peterbilt fault codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet advises first identifying which engine the Peterbilt uses, commonly PACCAR MX or Cummins, then retrieving the specific fault with a diagnostic scan tool and interpreting that exact code. Engine and controller context matters before applying a repair.

documents.title: Peterbilt BPV, air pressure and turbo-related P-codes
documents.summary: The WholeFleet list includes BPV position/CAN/command/current/temperature/power/calibration faults, post-air-temperature BPV range faults, a broken-turbine fault, boost/exhaust/pre-DOC pressure plausibility faults, air pressure pre-BPV range faults and DOC pressure high/low faults. Use the exact P-code to distinguish actuator, sensor, supply, plausibility and measured-pressure conditions.

documents.title: Peterbilt fuel pressure, rail pressure and filter P-codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet lists fuel-temperature plausibility, low fuel-pressure warning, rail-pressure buildup/high/plausibility/calibration/gradient conditions, high-pressure dump-valve feedback range faults, low-pressure-supply related control errors, hot-fuel conditions and clogged/very-clogged fuel-filter indications. Diagnose supply pressure, restriction, sensor plausibility, commanded versus actual rail pressure and valve control before replacing components.

documents.title: Peterbilt injector circuit and cylinder fault P-codes
documents.summary: The source provides extensive cylinder-specific injector needle-valve open/short-to-ground/short-to-battery and grouped high-side circuit faults for cylinders 1-6, plus injector spill-valve circuit faults. Exact P-code and cylinder must be retained; inspect wiring, connectors and driver circuits before concluding the injector itself failed.

documents.title: Peterbilt misfire, crank and cam P-codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet includes cylinder combustion-balance indications, intermittent misfire codes for individual cylinders, CSID combustion fault, no/corrupt crank signal and no/corrupt cam synchronization faults. Crank/cam faults can be associated with startup or long-crank symptoms; verify signal integrity and related faults before parts replacement.

documents.title: Peterbilt EGR, VGT and airflow P-codes
documents.summary: The source includes EGR mass-flow low/high/plausibility faults; airflow-sensor range, accuracy, pulsation, temperature, checksum, supply and burn-off faults; VGT status/data/learn/power/temperature faults; EGR rate and cooler-temperature faults; EGR actuator CAN/current/temperature/power/position/calibration faults; stuck-open/stuck-closed EGR faults and EGR-related derate/PM/SCR-heating conditions.

documents.title: Peterbilt DEF, SCR and emissions inducement P-codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet lists DEFOI/urea consumption, dosing, EGR-system, monitoring and urea-quality categories plus torque reduction, staged urea-level warnings, vehicle-speed-limit and engine-speed-limit faults. It also includes an SCR heating-mode diagnosis code. Treat inducement/derate codes as outcomes requiring diagnosis of the underlying DEF/SCR/EGR fault chain.

documents.title: Peterbilt wheel speed, vehicle speed and transmission speed P-codes
documents.summary: The source maps P1158-P1161 to front/rear left/right wheel-speed out-of-range faults, P1162 to a vehicle-speed message range fault, P1163 to transmission output-shaft speed out of range, and P1501-P1505 to vehicle-speed sensor open, short, frequency and PWM signal faults.

documents.title: Peterbilt oil, coolant and electrical supply P-codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet includes high coolant-temperature warning, oil-system temperature high, low oil-level startup warning, oil pressure high/low monitor faults, coolant-level sensor range and low-level warning, low battery supply, oil-temperature signal faults and 5-volt reference high/low faults. Diagnose the exact sensor/supply/measured-condition distinction before replacing a sensor.

documents.title: Peterbilt engine protection and derate P-codes
documents.summary: WholeFleet identifies P1105 as engine-protection approaching-shutdown state and P1106 as derated-performance state. These states should prompt diagnosis of the triggering faults and operating condition rather than treating the protection-state code itself as the root cause.
